title: Cub Scout adventure (canonical entity file)
description: One file per adventure: data/adventures/<slug>.json. Adventures are the unit of Cub Scout advancement — a rank is earned by completing six required adventures plus any two electives — so they are entities in their own right, the Cub-side analogue of merit badges. Requirement content lives in separate requirement-set documents (subject 'adventure:<slug>'), not here; each rank's requirement-set carries only the advancement structure and refs each adventure. Retirement is a 'discontinued' event plus a closed final version window; replacement chains (the 2024 program rewrote the adventure line-up wholesale) are 'superseded' events in data/adventures/_events.json.

id.description: The adventure's own canonical slug on scouting.org (e.g. 'pick-my-path-lion'), not a slugified name.

versions.description: Chronologically ordered, non-overlapping snapshots (pipeline-enforced). A new version window is opened by renames and by moves between ranks or categories.

name.description: Official adventure name during this window. Names are often rank-qualified by Scouting America itself (e.g. 'Champions for Nature Wolf', 'Bobcat Arrow of Light').

program.description: Program the adventure belongs to (e.g. cub_scouts).

ranks.description: Rank(s) offering this adventure during this window. Almost every adventure belongs to exactly one rank; the shooting-sports adventures Slingshot and BB Guns are offered across several. The authoritative placement — which group, and how many to choose — is the rank's own requirement-set; this field is the reverse index, and the pipeline checks the two agree.

category.description: Placement within the rank: see data/vocab/adventure-categories.json. Consistent across ranks for adventures offered by more than one.

area.description: The requirement area this adventure fills for its rank: see data/vocab/adventure-areas.json. Every rank's six required adventures fill the six areas exactly once each, which is what makes 'what does this Scout still need' a group-by rather than a list diff. **null for electives** — an elective fills no area. Pipeline-enforced: non-null exactly when category is 'required', and complete per rank.

url.description: Authoritative adventure page. null for the shooting-sports adventures, which are listed on the rank pages but have no page of their own.

description.description: Short original-prose description. Never verbatim requirement text.
